basics.type: State private university approved by the Government of Uttarakhand in 2021; began in 1998 as College of Engineering Roorkee (Seth Roshan Lal Jain Trust)
basics.campus: 7th km, Roorkee–Haridwar Road, Vardhmanpuram, Roorkee (Haridwar district)
basics.other: Roorkee's first private engineering college (1998). Engineering, computer applications, management, commerce, pharmacy and diplomas

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and one listed subject, 45% (40% reserved)
Merit-based; lateral entry through UKSEE or a B.Sc with Maths
Class 12 with Physics and Chemistry, plus Maths or Biology

scholarships.text: A scholarship test with 100% for first place, 50% for ranks 2–11, 30% for ranks 12–21 and 25% for all other participants, plus a single girl child scholarship.

hostel.text: On-campus hostels with a separate hostel enquiry desk.

fees.text: For B.Tech Mechanical (2026 intake), years two to four cost ₹1,10,200 a year: ₹81,400 tuition, ₹20,000 academic services and ₹8,800 examination. Ask us for the fee for your course.
